searched_but_not_found: DELIVERY: Foodpanda does not cover Joypurhat. foodpanda.com.bd/city/joypurhat says 'We're not in your area yet', and Joypurhat (and its upazila towns) is not on foodpanda.com.bd/city. Foodpanda's Bangla page 'jaipurhat' (under rajshahi) actually lists Rajshahi-city restaurants: two that were checked have Rajshahi addresses. No other delivery app (Pathao Food, Foodi, Hungrynaki) was found serving Joypurhat. Kacchi Bhai has no Joypurhat branch. MENUS: no restaurant website, aggregator or delivery page with a priced Joypurhat menu was found. The only prices are from a 2023 Prothom Alo feature (Azizul's Hotel) and a 2024 travel blog (Azad Hotel, approximate). These were blocked to fetching (robots/errors): Facebook pages (Cafe Orange, Hungry Birds, The Lounge, Tastyhub Joypurhat, J-Cloud), jcloudbd.com, bangladesh-places.com, restaurantguru, au.trip.com, top-rated.online, amader24.com, thefriendsbd.com, joypurhat.gov.bd, bfsa.joypurhat.gov.bd, Cybo sub-pages and filters. PHOTOS: every commons.wikimedia.org page and the Commons/Wikipedia APIs returned errors to WebFetch (URL_NOT_FOUND, even for robots.txt), so no licence could be checked and dish_photos is empty. Candidate file pages seen only in search results are in dish_photo_candidates_unverified; do not use them until their licences are checked. The session then hit its WebSearch limit (200) and WebFetch limit (400/hour). SKIPPED: Cybo entries Rafi Coffee House and হাজী হোটেল (address Madhabpur, Dhaka–Sylhet Highway, not in Joypurhat); placeholder entries all at 32WF+P34 (Tergati Border, Mayaghat, Chuanir Gudam, Md Jakir, Md Juwel Rana, Khrikata); 'Ratan' (marked may be closed); 'Bd shop'. Also skipped: names restaurantsbd.one gives only in its FAQ with no details (হোটেল পর্যটন, রূপসা রেস্তোরাঁ, সাজেদা কিচেন, স্বর্ণা ভোজন, গ্র্যান্ড সুলতান হোটেল, জাম্বুরা লাউঞ্জ); 'লোকান্ত ৫৯০০' (not clearly a restaurant); Ratul Bakery (named only in a Feb 2026 fine report); and an itinerant Akkelpur sweet seller (Samir Chandra Ghosh, Prothom Alo Jun 2026), who is not a shop. No restaurants could be sourced for Panchbibi, Kalai or Khetlal.
